initial.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production WALK-CYCLE SPRITE ATLAS for existing paper-cut animation. The supplied screenshot shows the problem of frozen walking pose; use it only for target direction and character identity, never copy its background or text. Generate one SINGLE 4-COLUMN by 2-ROW sprite sheet, landscape 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2048x1024. Eight equal invisible grid cells. ONE full-body instance in EACH cell, exactly eight instances total. Every instance exactly same character, head size, clothing, rightward facing angle and drawing scale. Body's hip stays horizontally centered on its cell; ground line is exactly the SAME height within each cell. All feet and hands fully visible, 10% transparent padding inside every cell, no overlapping neighboring cells. Real transparent alpha background with empty transparent gutters, NO floor shadows, glow, ground, scenery, text, frame labels, grid lines, numbering or checkerboard drawn in the image. Genuinely HAND-CUT matte colored PAPER COLLAGE, visible fine fibers, irregular edges, simple flat layers with short shadows ONLY between paper layers. No plastic 3D, no ink outlines, no anime, no realistic skin, no watercolor. European picture-book features, warm small smile and small natural eyes. Keep same calm face in every frame, no head turning. Chest/upper body remain steady, only slight natural vertical body bob. ANIMATION FRAME ORDER: read left to right across top row, then left to right across bottom row. Exactly 8 sequential phases of ONE complete rightward walking gait (NOT 8 unrelated poses). Camera fixed, looking at the character's right-facing side with very slight three-quarter face visibility. Frame 1 CONTACT A: near leg extended forward to right, heel touches floor, far leg extended back to left with toe down; near arm back, far arm forward. Frame 2 DOWN A: front knee flexes taking weight, back heel lifts, pelvis slightly down. Frame 3 PASSING A: near support leg vertical beneath hip, far swing leg bends and passes forward under torso, arms pass by torso. Frame 4 UP A: near supporting heel raised, far knee lifted forward preparing contact, pelvis slightly up. Frame 5 CONTACT B: FAR leg extended forward to right, near leg extended BACK to left; NEAR arm forward and far arm back, the opposite to frame 1. Frame 6 DOWN B: far front knee flexes, near trailing heel lifts. Frame 7 PASSING B: far support leg vertical, NEAR knee bends and passes forward under torso. Frame 8 UP B: far support heel raised, near knee lifted preparing next contact A. After frame 8 loop directly to frame 1 without a duplicate end frame. Knees must visibly bend and feet lift in passing poses; distinct arm swings and alternating support feet; character NOT frozen in a spread-leg walking icon. Hands never point and no waving. Distinguish near and far limbs with subtle cut-paper overlap/shade, never change clothing color. SUBJECT: exactly the 10-year-old BOY in reference image 1: same chestnut paper hair, fair warm skin, cream T-shirt with mustard sun emblem and seafoam collar, sage-green SHORTS, cream sneakers and short socks. Preserve exact identity and silhouette. No girl. Same simple hair pieces in all 8 cells.

correction.prompt: EDIT this existing 8-cell WALK SPRITE SHEET. Keep the EXACT character design, face, hair, clothes, handmade paper-collage materials and 4-column x 2-row layout. Fix animation sequencing, not a redesign. The current sheet incorrectly nearly repeats the top row in bottom row. Make bottom row an unmistakably OPPOSITE STEP, especially the foreground arm. All figures face RIGHT at same view angle. TOP ROW four phases: foreground/NEAR leg is leading initially, foreground/NEAR arm swings BACK to LEFT; then body lowers, legs pass, body rises. BOTTOM ROW four phases: foreground/NEAR leg is TRAILING initially toward LEFT, foreground/NEAR arm swings FORWARD to RIGHT; then body lowers, legs pass, body rises. In BOTTOM ROW FIRST TWO figures the clearly visible near arm MUST extend toward RIGHT in front of torso, never repeat the backward arm of top row first two. In bottom passing frame near leg sweeps forward from behind while far leg bears weight. Use slight darker paper for far limbs to make alternating feet legible. Make stride relaxed, not marching: bent knee lift modest, toes below mid-calf, no high-stepping thigh at horizontal. 8 sequential poses visibly different, no duplicate poses between rows. Preserve height, head size, full body, outfit details and face consistently. Every invisible equal grid cell has a large clear padding margin: figure fills no more than 80% of cell height, horizontally centered at pelvis. Same floor baseline within each cell, no floor drawn. Both rows fit completely inside sheet. REAL transparent background and empty gutters, no glow, no fake checkerboard, no grid or lettering. Clean cut-paper silhouettes. One complete eight-phase gait, top row contact-down-passing-up with near foot leading; bottom row contact-down-passing-up with far foot leading. At least two poses each row show legs close together passing under hip, not all wide legged. Keep chestnut hair, cream sun T-shirt, green shorts and cream sneakers.
